project_protected_note: FR3 (design Task 32): inside every project directory (the root of a project instance, and every examples/<name>/ project), the protocol directory is protected like the paths above: a change needs the approver. bench.json binds the protocol file by sha256 and bench_model refuses an unbound or edited file. FR3-04: an APPROVED protocol also needs protocol/approval.json (schemas/bench-protocol-approval.json) with the sha256 of the protocol file and its approval reference; a mismatch BLOCKS every plan, run, check and decide of the project. The binding is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof: the record is unsigned, and review of this protected directory is the control.
